<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex034062026-11-1603-54-23" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3818">bya</rs>'i zhal nas dge slong dang dge slong mi'i sdom pa ni spong pa bdun gyi mtshan nyid can yin te | lus kyi s3ra dang gi gzhag zhes nges pa'i phyir ro || zhes pa de la nongs byas pa yin te 'ong ste | de ni gnyen po'i grangs nges bstan pa yin la | spang bya dang gnyen po khyab mnyam yin nas |
               <lb edRef="inst:4707" n="N010"/>dge' slong dang dge' song ma 2 gsol ba dang ng 'i las kyi tha ma la skye 'o ||
          
            <pb n="15"/>
         
               <lb edRef="inst:4707" n="N001"/>| de skad bshad pa ni ma yin no ||</seg></TEI>
